purpose: Existing parser/operand surfaces for the 35 selected O-table commands; pair with o-options-inventory.json for missing selected work and declarations

cut.operands: FILE... or stdin; one selected list mode, selected single-byte field delimiter; numeric/range list grammar.
boundaries: C-byte character mode; no full multibyte locale claim

uniq.operands: [INPUT [OUTPUT]]; adjacent-group processing and selected output-file safety.
boundaries: C-byte comparison; group modes are separately absent

comm.operands: Exactly FILE1 FILE2; sorted dual-stream merge, - stdin.
boundaries: C-byte key ordering; locale collation excluded

join.operands: Exactly FILE1 FILE2; selected fields, explicit output-list and equal-key Cartesian runs.
boundaries: C-byte field/order profile; legacy/common GNU aliases not inferred from semantic option IDs

wc.operands: FILE... or stdin; --files0-from supplies NUL-separated names.
boundaries: Existing C-profile count/word/display-width definitions; no full locale claim

sort.operands: FILE... or stdin; selected key-position/modifier and --sort normalization already exist.
boundaries: In-memory sorting; external budget/merge/output/random features are separate work
No locale collation; -R rejects deterministic seed ambiguity

seq.operands: [FIRST [INCREMENT]] LAST; one to three exact decimal/exponent values; negative numeric tokens retained.
boundaries: 4096-character numeric operand and exponent/scale bounds; format option absent

fmt.operands: FILE... or stdin; width0..2500 and goal<=width.
boundaries: C-byte columns and bounded paragraph reflow; crown/tag/prefix missing

printf.operands: FORMAT [ARGUMENT...]; repeat format to consume arguments; %b interprets escapes.
boundaries: C-profile numeric/byte formatting; a/A/q conversions are missing work

expand.operands: FILE... or stdin; ascending absolute tab stops or a repeated single interval.
boundaries: /N/+N trailing grammar absent; C-byte column rules

unexpand.operands: FILE... or stdin; fixed ascending tab stops or repeated interval.
boundaries: /N/+N trailing grammar absent; C-byte columns and ordered all/first-only semantics

split.operands: [FILE [PREFIX]]; default stdin; basic numeric suffix starts0; exclusive output creation and suffix growth/exhaustion exist.
boundaries: Chunk/filter/line-bytes/hex/FROM extensions absent; source is not the planned bounded resource implementation

csplit.operands: FILE PATTERN...; line numbers, /regex/, %regex%, offsets and selected repeat grammar.
boundaries: Current buffering/indexing not R2 spool acceptance; custom formatter/suppress-matched absent

rev.operands: Zero or one FILE; default/- stdin; >1 rejects despite FILE... help.
boundaries: Whole-input buffered C-byte reversal; multi-file and per-record resource work remain

tac.operands: Zero or one FILE; default/- stdin; >1 rejects despite FILE... help.
boundaries: Fixed separator only; regex/multifile and reverse-block/stdin-spool work remain

od.operands: FILE... or stdin; selected byte/integer formats and offsets.
boundaries: Floating aliases/ABI, strings and traditional offset/label absent

hexdump.operands: FILE... or stdin; selected repeatable built-in formats.
boundaries: Positive stdin skip has erroneous seek-API refusal despite discard implementation; custom/color formats absent
Print-bytes absent; preserve first difference/EOF/quiet error priority

strings.operands: FILE... or stdin; s/S 7/8-bit scanning and selected minimum/radix.
boundaries: Wide/object/Unicode/locale extraction and output separator absent; bounded continuation work remains

xxd.operands: Zero or one FILE; optional output operand absent; forward nonnegative discard and positive plain-reverse prefix exist.
boundaries: Addressed reverse ignores -s; most selected display/address extensions absent
Existing-target output needs identity/handle-truncation policy

cksum.operands: FILE... or stdin; POSIX CRC32 and byte length.
boundaries: GNU alternate digest/check/tag/base64/raw modes absent

md5sum.operands: FILE... or stdin; check mode parses GNU untagged manifests.
boundaries: Tagged digest/check mode absent; preserve existing byte/escape/status profile

sha1sum.operands: FILE... or stdin; GNU untagged manifest checks.
boundaries: Tagged digest/check mode absent; pure incremental SHA1 already exists

sha256sum.operands: FILE... or stdin; standalone SHA256 implementation/checker.
boundaries: Tagged digest/check mode absent; CR escaping discrepancy versus shared checksums is unverified

sha512sum.operands: FILE... or stdin; GNU untagged manifest checks.
boundaries: Tagged digest/check mode absent; incremental public crypto state already used
Lexical -s/-m, relative output/quiet absent; physical missing-component symlink semantics need documented readlink capability

mktemp.operands: Zero or one TEMPLATE; default TMPDIR or /tmp plus tmp.XXXXXX; secure random/atomic creation.
boundaries: Full GNU template/tmpdir/-t/suffix/quiet absent; unsafe -u remains excluded

mkdir.operands: DIRECTORY...; numeric modes and leaf creation/chmod exist.
boundaries: Symbolic mode evaluation absent; omitted-who umask and Windows mode behavior need explicit discovery

rm.operands: FILE...; explicit final dot/dotdot/root safety and ordered failure paths.
boundaries: Interactive modes absent; prompt API/behavior must be discovered without weakening existing policy

ls.operands: FILE... or current directory; current output is one name/classification per line.
boundaries: Layouts/width/tab/quoting/explicit-color absent; do not fabricate unavailable link/owner/mode/inode metadata

tree.operands: DIR... or current directory; current traversal/count/depth renderer.
boundaries: Selected structured/filter/prune/size/color modes absent; ordinary-file algorithms separate from link/metadata API limits

env.operands: NAME=VALUE... [COMMAND ARG...]; first assignment ends option parsing; child arguments remain literal.
boundaries: Split-string absent; direct-child launch/environment behavior exists

xargs.operands: [COMMAND ARG...]; batch/token/quote/NUL/replacement/eof and bounded parallel child scheduling exist.
boundaries: Delimiter/prompt modes absent; independent confirmation channel needs capability discovery
Catalog omits several actually implemented limits/eof/show-limits options

tail.operands: FILE... or stdin; signed line/byte origins, selected header/descriptor-follow behavior.
boundaries: NUL records absent; name-follow -F identity/rotation requires explicit policy and API work

tee.operands: FILE... plus stdout; stdin byte-copy loop with per-file continuation.
boundaries: Output-error modes/-p absent; actual pipe/file error classification must be checked before asserting an API gap
